shyamal:
Namaste Shyamal Group team, IV Infotech (Mehsana) se.

Meta Ad Library me maine Shyamal Park Lane (Bhayli, Vadodara) ka Diwali ad dekha: 3 versions, sab 16 Oct se chal rahe hain. Ek me Send WhatsApp message button hai, baaki do me Get quote form. (21 Oct ko dekha)

Sawal: jo buyer WhatsApp button dabata hai, use pehla reply kitni der me milta hai?

Hum Shyamal Park Lane ke liye WhatsApp par automatic first reply banate hain (lagbhag 1 minute me): brochure, 3 chhote sawal (3 ya 4 BHK, budget, timeline), site-visit time, aur team ko ek list ki kaun visit ke liye ready hai. Buyer ko pata hota hai ki reply automatic hai; team kabhi bhi chat le sakti hai.

Upar 40 second ka video Shyamal Park Lane ke liye hi hai.
Page: https://www.ivinfotech.com/campaign/shyamal-park-lane-k4m8vz
Demo apne phone par: https://wa.me/15559597730?text=Yes%2C%20send%20the%20demo%20for%20Shyamal%20Park%20Lane
Ya bas DEMO reply kar do.

Email bhi bheja hai. Nahi chahiye to STOP likh do.
